2609.35767.title: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning
2609.35767.paper_summary: Unified multimodal models can both look at and render images, so in principle they can repair their own generations: diagnose what an image gets wrong, revise it, observe the result, and diagnose again. Whether a revision helps is known only after it is rendered, so the reflection text and the image generation must be learned jointly, over the whole loop. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on reflection trajectories gives a cold start but does not find the high-success repair paths, and naive RL that optimizes only the renderer or only one head leaves most of the gain untapped. We introduce UMM-Reflection, which applies reinforcement learning (RL) to complete reflection trajectories inside one unified model: sibling trajectories share one initial image, so the group-relative advantage compares reflection strategies, and one trajectory-level advantage updates both the reflection tokens and the flow-based revisions, avoiding the combinatorial blow-up of per-round credit assignment. Unlike single-round editing or pipelines with an external critic, credit flows across rounds and to both roles of the same model, and no verifier is needed at inference. On BAGEL, UMM-Reflection improves GenEval by 12.05 points over SFT, and the gains transfer to WISE (+10.97), OneIG-Bench (+3.48), and T2I-CompBench++ (+4.63), none of which is used in training.
2609.35767.paper_summary_zh: 統一的多模態模型可以同時觀察和生成圖像，因此原則上它們可以修復自己的生成：診斷圖像出錯的地方，進行修正，觀察結果，然後再次診斷。修正是否有幫助只有在生成後才能知道，因此反思文本和圖像生成必須在整個循環中共同學習。對反思軌跡進行監督微調（SFT）會有冷啟動的情況，但無法找到高成功率的修復路徑，而僅優化渲染器或僅優化一個頭的天真強化學習（RL）會使大部分增益未被利用。我們引入了UMM-Reflection，它將強化學習應用於一個統一模型內完成反思軌跡：兄弟軌跡共享一個初始圖像，因此群體相對優勢比較反思策略，而一個軌跡級別的優勢同時更新反思標記和基於流的修正，避免了每輪信用分配的組合爆炸。與單輪編輯或有外部評估者的管道不同，信用在多輪之間流動，並且在同一模型的兩個角色之間流動，推理時不需要驗證者。在BAGEL上，UMM-Reflection使GenEval比SFT提高了12.05分，並且這些增益轉移到WISE（+10.97）、OneIG-Bench（+3.48）和T2I-CompBench++（+4.63），這些都沒有用於訓練。
